'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Dan Kim DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Kim]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Username:''' MrNiceGuy
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
